title: CI/CD in 60 seconds
caption: CI/CD in 60 seconds: every push gets tested and shipped by a machine, the same way every time. #cicd #devops #github

scenes.title: CI/CD
scenes.say: Some teams ship to production dozens of times a day, without panicking.
scenes.sub: Some teams ship to production dozens of times a day, without panicking.

scenes.say: Shipping by hand means a long checklist, and hoping nobody skips a step.
C I C D hands that to a machine, in two halves.

items.title: Continuous integration
items.text: every push is built and tested
items.say: Continuous integration: every push is built and tested automatically.

items.title: Continuous delivery
items.say: Continuous delivery: every build that passes can ship.

scenes.code:
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npm test
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
scenes.say: It's a file in your repo. Push, and the steps run, in order, every time.

scenes.text: Even demo videos can be a CI step: kaviri *films them from a script* on every push, so they never go stale.
scenes.say: One neat C I step: kaviri films your demo video from a script on every push, so it never goes stale.
That's C I C D. Small changes, shipped often, checked every time.
